decision_rule: §8 gate: the W2 candidate is eligible only if its paired validation Δ̄_lin vs G* (H1, M0) has CI lower bound > 0 (L_prob, all genes, U, no stratum); one candidate, so the §9 one-SE rule picks it if eligible and σ·√(2 ln m) = 0 (A11g).
notes: W2 M4 shortlist: M2(f=1) (documented base medium + supplements + serum model at f = 1, gate-free) on G* = Human1; [H2] is descriptive. Scores are line-specific (layout line_gene) over the 198 validation expression lines; 146 are in the medium-attribution set, the others get the integrated-pipeline medium (imputed/fallback/unmappable: classic RPMI + 10% FBS; onboarded: onboarded medium), as in line_sweeps.tsv; the harness cannot restrict the gate cell to the attribution set (strata are W1's). Training flags carried: W2-SHUF (beats_shuffled_medium = False), W2-MOPEN (M-open Δ̄_lin vs M0 = 0.0195), W2-CONST (post hoc: one line-constant classic RPMI + 10% FBS medium for every line scores higher than the documented per-line media on training); see results/w2/README.md §M4. Not to be combined with W3 B-loo variants here (M6 factorial).
